edges.description: The primary cilium houses the Hedgehog pathway, and an intact cilium is required for the response to a Smoothened agonist. Knockdown of the independent ciliogenesis factor TTBK2 reduced ciliation and abolished the same response, so the cilium rather than MED12 itself is the proximate requirement.

Reduced ciliary signaling during development is the proposed route to the ciliopathy-like features: retinopathy, biliary dysgenesis and fibrotic liver disease. Which cells lose cilia in which organ, and when, is not demonstrated.
Hedgehog signaling patterns many of the structures malformed in this syndrome. The organ-by-organ assignment is inferred from pathway biology rather than demonstrated in patient tissue.
YAP signaling has established roles in orofacial clefting and angiogenesis, both features of this syndrome.

Proposed, not demonstrated. The authors note that YAP and TGF-beta signaling modulate angiogenesis and cardiomyopathy, and separately that heart disease in this syndrome may arise independently of ciliary and YAP effects. Recorded as the leading hypothesis for the cardiovascular arm.
Maldevelopment of the intra- and extrahepatic biliary tree.
Preauricular pits and tags and branchial cleft anomalies are all first and second pharyngeal arch derivatives, which is consistent with their being the most frequent feature in the cohort.
A persistent omphalomesenteric duct remnant, so a midgut developmental failure alongside the malrotation.
Reduced growth is recorded in about a third of the cohort. Whether it is a primary consequence of the transcriptional defect or secondary to the cholestatic and feeding burden is not established.
Plausibly downstream of the enteric malformations rather than a separate lesion; the source scores it as a clinical finding without assigning a mechanism.
Impaired bile flow through a maldeveloped biliary tree produces cholestasis.
The severe end of the biliary maldevelopment, presenting as obstructive liver disease in infancy.
Agenesis of the gallbladder as one reported form of the biliary maldevelopment.
Choledochal cystic dilatation as another reported form of the biliary maldevelopment.
Aneurysmal dilatation of the carotid and posterior cerebral arteries, which with the vertebral aneurysm below is the vessel-wall half of this node.
The consequential event the vascular surveillance recommendation exists to pre-empt. Reported once in the vascular tabulation and once as a fatal unprovoked hemorrhage at age 21.
Shows that tissue-restricted Med12 loss is sufficient for cardiomyopathy in mouse.
edges.limitations: A cardiac-restricted conditional deletion is not the human genotype, which is a constitutive heterozygous truncating allele on one X chromosome subject to X-inactivation. The model speaks to cardiomyopathy alone and not to the arrhythmia or extracardiac vascular anomalies, and this entry cites it only through the 2024 paper's summary rather than from the primary report.

nodes.description: MED12 expression rises about two-fold in cells induced to form primary cilia and falls by about half during ciliary disassembly, and its knockdown reduces the ciliated fraction without shortening cilia. The reduction is not explained by cells cycling faster, since knockdown also halves proliferation. This places Hardikar syndrome partly within ciliopathy-spectrum biology, which is where its retinopathy, biliary dysgenesis and fibrotic liver disease overlap clinically.
